why_ai: Licensed investigators work in the field and testify to what they saw, while the screening half is screen-based record assembly that automation already reaches.
why_clarity: A report is complete or not and a record matches or not, but whether surveillance or a due diligence finding was right is learned late or never.
why_digital: Records, databases and reports are digital, but surveillance, courthouse pulls and interviews happen in person and buyers use regional panels.

why_ai: FCRA accuracy liability and court-access networks protect the product, but ordering, matching and reporting are automatable software work.
why_clarity: Each component returns a defined result under codified rules at enormous volume, though accuracy is tested only through disputes.
why_digital: Orders, consent and delivery run through APIs nationally, with some court records still pulled in person.

why_ai: Same-day decisioning on narrow packages is exactly what software does, and buyers switch vendors on turnaround.
why_clarity: Near-identical reports by the hundred thousand, judged on a clear same-day clear rate.
why_digital: Mobile consent, API ordering and ATS delivery; only slow courts need a person.

why_ai: Regulators and payers require accountable eligibility checks and cleared matches must be defensible, though list and licence checks automate.
why_clarity: Requirements are written by role and cadence, but a missed exclusion surfaces only at audit.
why_digital: Lists, licence boards and monitoring feeds are online; fingerprints are captured physically.

why_ai: A licensed investigator must be physically present, unseen, reading an adversarial subject in real time and may testify to it.
why_clarity: What counts as usable activity is contested and the veteran's read is tacit; whether evidence changed a claim is known months later.
why_digital: Starts from a person at an address and a car on a street, delivered as video and reports through regional panels.

why_ai: Terminal-only courts need a runner in the building, though every court that goes online removes the need.
why_clarity: A search for a name in a county returns a defined result checked against the index.
why_digital: Courthouse terminals and clerk counters in, typed or structured results out to national screeners.

why_ai: Clients pay for a firm's judgement and source network on high-stakes, often adversarial questions, though retrieval and drafting automate.
why_clarity: Report tiers are defined, but each subject is different and whether a red flag was missed may never be known.
why_digital: Registries, press and court records are mostly digital; source inquiries and foreign courthouse pulls are local and personal.

why_ai: Disputes and individualized assessments need accountable human review and legal aid advocates, and demand grows with fair-chance laws.
why_clarity: A record is corrected or not inside a fixed window, but mitigation and assessment are judgements.
why_digital: Court papers and sealing orders are often paper; disputes and portals are online; legal aid is partly in person.

why_ai: A licensed owner-investigator does field work and is hired on personal reputation with local lawyers and adjusters.
why_clarity: Every case is different and methods are personal; results are judged by clients, not checked.
why_digital: Databases and email are digital, but the work is fieldwork sold locally through referrals.

why_ai: Scripted verification calls and database lookups are directly replaceable by voice agents and instant sources.
why_clarity: Dates, titles and degrees are confirmed or not, thousands of times a day.
why_digital: Requests, databases, calls and results are all remote and screen-based, often offshore.

why_ai: Finding and preserving public posts is software work; account attribution and testimony keep some human judgement.
why_clarity: Captures are defined and repeat per subject, but attribution is a judgement tested only if challenged.
why_digital: Public online content in, captured files and reports out, bought by regional and national clients.

why_ai: Clients hire a named firm's judgement, discretion and sources on adversarial, high-stakes matters, often through counsel.
why_clarity: Engagements are bespoke and their correctness is rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Research is largely on screens, but source work and client relationships are personal and global.

why_ai: Boards and search partners rely on a trusted firm's discretion and reference work for consequential appointments.
why_clarity: A same-shaped report per candidate, but whether a finding mattered emerges years later.
why_digital: Public records and media in, reports out digitally to search firms worldwide; references are by phone.

why_ai: Finding and interviewing reluctant witnesses in person and testifying about it is adversarial, licensed and relationship-driven.
why_clarity: Each case is bespoke and success depends on people found and what they say.
why_digital: Fieldwork and interviews in person, bought by local law firms.

why_ai: Desk background and social media reports are screen research that AI search and capture tools now perform.
why_clarity: Templated reports per claimant at volume, with relevance judged by adjusters.
why_digital: Online sources and claim data in, digital reports out to carriers nationally.

why_ai: Bulk record collection and normalisation is data engineering; source agreements and court relationships are the protection.
why_clarity: Records are normalised to defined fields at huge volume, with errors surfacing through disputes.
why_digital: Bulk files in, searches and alerts out by API to screeners nationwide.

why_ai: Sworn investigators build cases against adaptive fraudsters that must survive prosecution.
why_clarity: Referral triage repeats, but case outcomes take years.
why_digital: Referral data is digital; investigations and prosecutions involve fieldwork and courts within one state.

why_ai: Vendor allocation and invoice audit are rules and analytics that software performs.
why_clarity: Guidelines and invoices are checked against defined rules.
why_digital: Assignments, invoices and reports move entirely through claims systems and portals.

why_ai: Embedded screening is a software feature resold by platforms.
why_clarity: Packages and workflows are standardised for SMB employers.
why_digital: Sold and delivered inside online payroll suites.

why_ai: An annual statistical summary of lab results is straightforward analysis software can produce.
why_clarity: Positivity rates are exact counts repeated each year.
why_digital: Lab result data in, published reports out online.

why_ai: Niche software vendors face AI-native competitors building the same workflows.
why_clarity: Product requirements are defined and releases tested, though customer fit is judged by renewal.
why_digital: Software built and sold remotely to agencies nationwide.

why_ai: Associations sell community, accreditation and advocacy, which members still value.
why_clarity: Advocacy and education outcomes are hard to measure.
why_digital: Mix of conferences, lobbying in person and online resources.

why_ai: Licensing is a statutory government function that will persist, though application processing automates.
why_clarity: Licence requirements are codified and applications repeat.
why_digital: Applications are online, but fingerprints and exams are in person within one state.

why_ai: Prints are captured in person and repositories are statutory, though matching is automated.
why_clarity: Submissions are processed under a fixed procedure with a definite result.
why_digital: Physical fingerprint capture at a local site, digital processing and response.

why_ai: Acquisition judgement and relationships with owners remain human.
why_clarity: Each deal differs and whether it worked is known years later.
why_digital: Models and data rooms on screens, with owner relationships built in person.
